title: Vibe-coded with Claude Code: a 2-player split-screen mine cart race for Donkey Kong Country (SNES)
author: SitePowerful1880
selftext:
Cart Chase 2P turns the mine cart levels of Donkey Kong Country into a head-to-head split-screen race. I vibe-coded it: I asked Claude Code to program it and it wrote all the code (about 13,000 lines of C, Python and JavaScript, over four weeks). My part was the game design, asking for features, playing every build and reporting what felt wrong.



The game:

\- 2 players, split screen; each controller picks its side on the start screen

\- 200+ seamless stages remixed from Mine Cart Carnage and Mine Cart Madness, plus a random stage generator

\- 8 world themes: the track goes through jungle, snow, factory, temple and more, with that world's graphics, music and enemies

\- Crash and only you rewind a few seconds; your rival keeps racing

\- Live timers, 1st/2nd place, best times per stage, sudden death, 1-player time trial

\- In-game stage editor (mouse + keyboard)



Under the hood: it runs on DKC1Recomp (a static recompilation of the SNES game to C) and keeps two complete copies of the game in one process, swapping their state every frame.



Design lessons from doing it with AI: describe the feel you want, not the code; play every build yourself; and ask for automatic tests (a bot that drives the cart to the finish line saved hours).



Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sTRl1Q-96Dk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sTRl1Q-96Dk)

Source: [https://github.com/irregbex/CartChase2P](https://github.com/irregbex/CartChase2P)



No ROMs included or provided. Only works with your own legal copy of Donkey Kong Country (USA) v1.0. Fan project, not affiliated with Nintendo or Rare.
